text:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: Major: GPU autoscaling failing — cluster-autoscaler can't add nodes to gpu-nodegroup-2, queue length for /generate jumped to 18k, customers seeing 503s and throttles. Pagerduty triggered for oncall-alex.

oncall-alex: ack I'm on it. Seeing repeated errors in cluster-autoscaler logs: `LaunchTemplate not found` for nodegroup launch-template-id and then `InsufficientInstanceCapacity` fallback. Also ASG reports at desired=20 max=20.

sre-maria: copying logs — cluster-autoscaler shows: `failed to launch: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform this operation` followed by `InvalidLaunchTemplateName.NotFound`. Could be an IAM role / launch template drift.

eng-ops-ryan: fwiw we rolled a launch-template change last night to adjust SGs for private subnets. Maybe name suffix changed. I pushed a new LT but didn't update the nodegroup ref (was trying to avoid disruption).

oncall-alex: customer-impact: endpoint /generate latency spiking -> our proxy is returning 503 when queue > 10k. CS Jess flagged 2 enterprise customers seeing timeouts and failed jobs. We should put a mitigation notice.

customer-success-jess: reported customers: acme.ai and finlytics. They want ETA. Please advise whether to enable fallback to CPU-hosted smaller model.

eng-runtime-zoe: we can toggle model-routing to fallback model and keep requests flowing while we fix infra. That reduces quality but prevents errors. I can flip routing to fallback for dedicated customers for a short window.

oncall-alex: do that. Zoe, switch routing for requests tagged `tier:dedicated` to small-gpu-fallback or cpu-medium for now. Post when done.

eng-runtime-zoe: done. Routing change applied. Traffic split 80/20 to fallback; latency for most dropped but token quality reduced. Monitoring shows queue dropping from 18k -> 4.5k within 7m.

sre-maria: meanwhile I'm going to triage autoscaler problem. Hypothesis: nodegroup LT name mismatch + ASG max at 20 + launch template IAM service role missing ec2:RunInstances permission for cluster autoscaler role.

eng-ops-ryan: confirmed the LT name in the eks nodegroup was `gpu-nd-2026-v2` but the new LT is `gpu-nd-2026-v3`. The nodegroup references the old LT; autoscaler is trying to use the new LT (due to autoscaler ASG mapping) and failing. Also ASG max=20 (we hit commit).

infra-bot: AWS Console note: ASG gpu-nodegroup-2 is at max size 20/20. ScalingPolicy: step-scaling present.

oncall-alex: action list: 1) increase ASG max to 40 to allow scale up; 2) patch nodegroup to correct launch template name or re-associate; 3) confirm IAM role permissions for CA; 4) restart cluster-autoscaler to pick up nodegroup map. Who owns each?

eng-ops-ryan: I'll handle 1 and 2. Can bump max to 40, but want approval because reserved quota and we may spin up extra GPU instances. Cost implications acknowledged.

sre-maria: I'll validate IAM permissions and restart cluster-autoscaler once LT is corrected.

oncall-alex: Ryan, go ahead. Use the manual capacity limit tag to avoid overspend: set autoscaling.max=40 and autoscaling.protect=on for critical pools. Keep me posted.

eng-ops-ryan: increasing ASG max -> set to 40 now. Command I ran:```aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-nodegroup-2 --max-size 40```

eng-ops-ryan: also re-linked the nodegroup to the correct launch template: updated nodegroup configuration to use `gpu-nd-2026-v3` (in EKS console did a `update-nodegroup-config --nodegroup-name gpu-nodegroup-2 --launch-template ...`). It reports update in progress.

sre-maria: checking IAM — cluster-autoscaler uses role `cluster-autoscaler-role`. It was missing `ec2:RunInstances` for the new launch template's instance profile because the LT referenced a new EC2 instance profile ARN that our CA role didn't have described access to. I patched the IAM policy to allow `iam:PassRole` and `ec2:RunInstances` scoped to the instance profile.

eng-runtime-zoe: queue now at ~1.2k and falling. Fallback routing still on for dedicated. Customer retries are succeeding for most.

infra-bot: EKS nodegroup update finished: new nodes are provisioning. 6 new GPU nodes went to `Provisioning` -> `Ready`.

eng-ops-ryan: despite nodes provisioning, cluster-autoscaler still logs `matching nodegroup not found for provisioned instance` occasionally. I'm going to restart cluster-autoscaler to refresh cloud provider cache.

sre-maria: restarted cluster-autoscaler deployment (`kubectl rollout restart deployment cluster-autoscaler -n kube-system`). Watch logs.

eng-ops-ryan: logs now show scale events and node registrations: `Successfully added 6 nodes`, kube-scheduler placing pods. Throttle errors for /generate decreased 95%.

oncall-alex: customer-impact update for CS: queue peaked ~18k, now stabilized <1k, majority requests served via fallback while we scaled. We should prepare an incident summary for acme.ai and finlytics. Jess, can you draft notifications?

customer-success-jess: drafting. Will say: brief outage for GPU-backed generation due to autoscaling/launch-template mismatch; mitigations: routed to fallback, increased nodegroup capacity, corrected LT and IAM, restarted autoscaler; ETA for full quality return 30-60m while batch caches warm.

eng-runtime-zoe: turning off fallback routing in 20m and will monitor model-quality metrics. We should run QA evals on a sample set before fully switching.

sre-maria: postmortem notes so far: root cause = launch template name drift + ASG max at commit limit + IAM policy missing `iam:PassRole`/`ec2:RunInstances` for CA on the updated instance profile. Contributing factor = last-night LT change not reflected in nodegroup config. Mitigations: enforce LT change checklist, add CI check to detect LT/name mismatch, alert when ASG at >90% of max (we had none), tighten autoscaler error alerts.

oncall-alex: add temporary guardrail: set monitoring alert for cluster-autoscaler error rate >5/min to page SRE directly. Also add automated fallback routing when queue > 5k for >3m.

eng-ops-ryan: filing infra ticket to roll back night change process and add post-deploy verification.

eng-runtime-zoe: fallback routing disabled. Traffic now fully on primary models. Observability: token success rate back to normal, no 503s for last 6m.

inc-bot: Incident transitioned to "mitigated". Please capture timeline and owners for postmortem.

oncall-alex: thanks team. I'll run the postmortem doc tomorrow morning with the notes here. If anyone has raw logs or commands used, drop them in the postmortem doc. Closing thread after doc link posted.
